blocks.text: Store interior design and custom furniture, 50 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed an interior design project for a 50 m² store and manufactured custom retail furniture for it. The small floor area had to comfortably accommodate merchandise, customers, and staff while preserving a cohesive look for the store. The furniture was designed around the room’s dimensions, product display and storage, and the company’s brand identity. Below are photorealistic 3D visualizations of the project.
